correctness.rationale: The mask predicate tests each outside vertex for 0 or at least 2 neighbours; the subfort-existence recurrence is nonmonotonic-safe and yields minimality exactly. Independently enumerated all 2^16 vertex masks, obtaining 348 forts with sizes {4:28,6:32,8:288}; generated all 384 affine cube automorphisms and partitioned the set into exactly five disjoint orbits (12,16,32,96,192) with the displayed canonical masks. This exhausts the finite claim; no higher-dimensional implication is inferred.
